title: Exact transport formulas for the two evaluation arrows
statement: Let l be a prime, E a finite extension of the l-adic rationals, T a scheme, c Chern data [def-sp-tower-class-chern], f an arbitrary integral degree-two arrow from its coefficient single to its root single, and n a natural number. The scalar evaluation arrow [def-sfb-finite-boundary-arrows] equals mapSingleArrow for finite evaluation followed by finite coefficient forgetting, then the shifted single of the forgotten lineEvaluation map [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. The integral evaluation arrow equals the single of the evaluated integerGenerator, followed by mapSingleArrow for recorded forgetting and finite evaluation applied to f, followed by the shifted single of the evaluated rootForget [def-sp-tower-class-systems, def-sp-tower-class-chern].

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: The scalar formula is forgetEvaluatedArrow_eq specialized to the two functors in its unchanged definition.

The integral formula is map_underlyingSingleArrow specialized to recorded forgetting, abelian evaluation, integerGenerator and rootForget. These formulas keep subsequent proofs from repeatedly unfolding the derived comparison definitions.

theorem scalarFiniteBoundary_eval_eq (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
        c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) (n : ℕ) :
    scalarFiniteBoundary_eval l E c f n =
      mapSingleArrow (SpTowerShriek.ev l E T n ⋙ finiteForget l E T n) (2 : ℤ)
          (scalarChernArrow l E c f) ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (DiagonalAb T) 0).map
          ((finiteForget l E T n).map (lineEvaluation l E c n).hom))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧'
